title: Freestanding 4-Arm Swing Towel Stand 49-Inch Solid Brass Assorted Free Standing Accessorie | Sea Foam Green | Allied Brass
body_html:
Add flexible towel storage to your bathroom without wall mounting with this freestanding 4-arm swing towel stand, crafted from solid brass with a heavy base for stability in Sea Foam Green, which captures the tranquil essence of ocean-inspired design, bringing soft, natural color to coastal and contemporary spaces.

  • Sea Foam Green transforms this essential into a conversation piece
  • Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
  • Solid brass construction: designed for corrosion-free and rust-free performance
  • Stability + floor protection: heavy solid brass base helps prevent tipping; felt pad helps prevent scratching
  • Coordinated look: part of the Soho collection with multiple designer finish options available

Specs

  • Collection: Soho
